_comment: The mandrel station's build (MandrelStation/README.md, 'Build order'): its one stage after the frame, the mandrel, as its rig's parts draw it; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema) and kept by the shared machine base (docs/modeling/machine-base.md). One rod of iron, meteoric iron or steel (drawn in that metal). A hand station: nothing wears. No block: the station's construction record is its own in the recipe export, not the ore machines' generic one.
